bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
dest=/mnt/g/Gserver/CreateVdobot/media-work
test -d /mnt/g || exit 31
mountpoint -q /mnt/g || exit 32
test "$(df -Pm /mnt/g | tail -1 | awk '{print $4}')" -ge 5120 || exit 33
test ! -L /mnt/g/Gserver && test ! -L /mnt/g/Gserver/CreateVdobot && test ! -L "$dest" || exit 34
mkdir -p "$dest" || exit 35
test -d "$dest" && test -w "$dest" || exit 36
docker run --rm --network none -v "$dest:/var/lib/videobot/media-work:rw" --entrypoint node create-videobot:video-dualmode-button-download-dc4578de -e "const f=require('fs'),p='/var/lib/videobot/media-work/.gace-dualmode-write-probe';f.writeFileSync(p,'ok',{flag:'wx',mode:0o600});if(f.readFileSync(p,'utf8')!=='ok')process.exit(1);f.unlinkSync(p)" >/dev/null || exit 37
echo G_DRIVE_VIDEO_WORK_DISK_BACKED_BIND_TEST_PASS
